merges.justification: Both clusters describe the same event in scene 1: Asha stepping inside the sewing room and stopping to look around. The descriptions and evidence are effectively identical.

merges.canonical_name: Asha closes sewing room and postpones opening desk
aliases: asks to reopen sewing room later
merges.justification: Both clusters refer to the same closing action and statement that Asha wants to return the next day with everyone present before the desk is opened. The evidence overlaps directly.

unmerged.name: Asha interrupts the argument
unmerged.justification: Distinct event where Asha tells others to stop and the room falls silent; no evidence it is the same as any other listed event.

unmerged.name: orders house search and attorney call
unmerged.justification: Separate announcement by Lucia about searching the house and calling an attorney; different narrative action from the other clusters.

unmerged.name: Asha prefers Rosa as guide
unmerged.justification: A distinct conversational choice by Asha to have Rosa show her the rooms, not the same as the later room-entry or desk-inspection events.

unmerged.name: Rosa leads Asha through the house
unmerged.justification: Separate movement event of Rosa guiding Asha upstairs and naming rooms; not identical to entering the sewing room or later discussion.

unmerged.name: Sewing room is shown tidy
unmerged.justification: This is a descriptive reveal of the room's condition and contents, not the same event as Asha entering it.

unmerged.name: Asha inspects desk without opening it
unmerged.justification: Distinct action focused on the roll-top desk; different from entering the room or closing it afterward.

unmerged.name: Asha asks about room access after death
unmerged.justification: Separate question about whether anyone has been in the room since Lucia died.

unmerged.name: Rosa admits room was accessed
unmerged.justification: Distinct response about dusting and Lucia sitting in the room; not the same as the question or other access-related events.

unmerged.name: Asha asks about Daniel's access
unmerged.justification: A separate follow-up question specifically about Daniel.

unmerged.name: Rosa reports uncertain room access
unmerged.justification: Distinct testimony about not knowing whether Daniel entered and recalling the door state on different days.

unmerged.name: Rosa confirms key always stayed in lock
unmerged.justification: Separate factual statement about the desk key remaining in the lock.

unmerged.name: identifies October attorney
unmerged.justification: Different informational event about recalling the attorney's name and choosing him over Mr. Halloran.

unmerged.name: thanks Rosa and leaves room
unmerged.justification: Separate departure event where Asha thanks Rosa and they walk back down the hallway.

unmerged.name: Rosa defends the boy
unmerged.justification: Distinct later conversation at the top of the stairs about the boy's upbringing and character.

unmerged.name: imagines locked desk and closed door
unmerged.justification: Internal reflection by Asha, not the same as any concrete interaction event.

unmerged.name: begin reviewing Serrano file at home
unmerged.justification: A separate evening scene in Asha's apartment reviewing the file and taking notes.
